latest_updates.title: 63rd Regular Session of the Sangguniang Bayan of Santa Cruz
latest_updates.excerpt: The 63rd Regular Session tackled key legislative matters on public health, barangay development, supplemental budgets, disaster preparedness, and local transportation services in Santa Cruz, Davao del Sur.

latest_updates.title: 62ND REGULAR SESSION | SANGGUNIANG BAYAN OF SANTA CRUZ
latest_updates.excerpt: The Sangguniang Bayan of Santa Cruz tackled key legislative matters, including the Children’s Welfare Code, ₱210-million Supplemental Budget No. 4 for CY 2026, and priority development initiatives.

latest_updates.title: SCFRB Deliberates on Franchise Applications and Transport Concerns
latest_updates.excerpt: The Santa Cruz Franchising and Regulatory Board (SCFRB), presided over by Vice Mayor Atty. Charlotte Gallego, deliberates on franchise unit additions, dropping of units, and other transport concerns to promote a safer and more organized public transportation system.
